prompt:
Write a WhatsApp group chat export in English for a fictional UPI-fraud training case.
Group members (use exactly these names as senders): Karthik ji, Pooja S., Pooja ji, Kavita ji.
The chat covers 14/03/26, 8:15 pm to 14/03/26, 10:15 pm. It must have exactly 22 message lines, in time order.
Line format, one message per line, nothing else:
DD/MM/YY, h:mm am - Sender: message text
These messages must appear word for word, in this order, with these exact timestamps and senders:
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja ji: Kavita ji, delete the transfer record right now
Fill the other lines with ordinary conversation. Do not add a header or explanations.
Fix these problems from your previous attempt:
- F1: chat.txt:12 at 9:20 pm vs calls.csv row 3 at 21:25 differs by 5 min (tolerance 2)
text:
14/03/26, 8:17 pm - Karthik ji: Has everyone reviewed the monthly budget report?
14/03/26, 8:22 pm - Pooja S.: Yes Karthik ji, I checked the figures earlier today.
14/03/26, 8:28 pm - Kavita ji: I will check it in a few minutes, just finishing up dinner.
14/03/26, 8:33 pm - Pooja ji: Let us discuss the pending vendor payments first.
14/03/26, 8:39 pm - Karthik ji: Sure, which vendor payments are still pending?
14/03/26, 8:44 pm - Pooja S.: The catering service and the stationery suppliers are pending.
14/03/26, 8:50 pm - Kavita ji: I have the invoices ready for both of them.
14/03/26, 8:56 pm - Pooja ji: Great, please share the payment links when ready.
14/03/26, 9:03 pm - Karthik ji: Did we get approval for the training program expenses?
14/03/26, 9:10 pm - Pooja S.: Yes, management approved it yesterday afternoon.
14/03/26, 9:17 pm - Kavita ji: That is good news, we can finalize the schedule now.
14/03/26, 9:25 pm - Karthik ji: I will call you shortly to discuss the final details.
14/03/26, 9:26 pm - Pooja ji: Kavita ji, delete the transfer record right now
14/03/26, 9:31 pm - Kavita ji: Done, I have removed it from the system log.
14/03/26, 9:36 pm - Pooja S.: Wait, which transfer record was deleted?
14/03/26, 9:42 pm - Karthik ji: Let us keep the technical issues for tomorrow morning.
14/03/26, 9:47 pm - Pooja ji: Yes, we can review the remaining items in office tomorrow.
14/03/26, 9:53 pm - Kavita ji: Alright, I will update the master sheet in the morning.
14/03/26, 9:59 pm - Pooja S.: Sounds good, please send the meeting invite for 10 AM.
14/03/26, 10:05 pm - Karthik ji: I will schedule the meeting and send calendar invites.
14/03/26, 10:10 pm - Pooja ji: Thanks everyone, good night.
14/03/26, 10:14 pm - Kavita ji: Good night all.
